title: Mahābhārata
attributionNote: Mahābhārata, as Heritage IITKanpur's Scripture Server catalogues it (MBH), on its own shelf.
description: The Mahābhārata, traditionally ascribed to Vyāsa, is the longer of the two Sanskrit epics: some seventy-odd thousand verses in eighteen books (parvas). It tells of the feud between the Pāṇḍavas and the Kauravas that ends in the eighteen-day war at Kurukṣetra, and gathers around it myth, genealogy, statecraft, law and philosophy, including works read on their own such as the Bhagavad Gītā. Its subject is dharma, what right conduct is when duties conflict, and its purpose is to teach it through story and argument; one of the two itihāsas, it carries Vedic teaching into example. It is for every reader, and is usually entered through a single parva or episode. The summary above is the one Heritage IITKanpur's Scripture Server publishes for the text, and the server's own metadata records it as AI-assisted (claude-opus-5-5); an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Heritage Scripture Server corpus, which continues the Gita Supersite built at IIT Kanpur: the text, its classical commentaries and the translations the server may serve are held together there.
availabilityNote: The outline is held: 18 chapter(s) and 73817 verse address(es), read from the server's own catalogue. The verses are not stored — the licence forbids bulk harvesting and database reconstruction — and are streamed from the API one verse at a time as the work is read, with the attribution HCAL-1.1 requires and the server's own quota and licence notice.

editions.rightsStatus: Tier A (the moolam and its transliterations): no modern copyright, freely redistributable. Where the API serves Tier B — the Sanskrit bhāṣya and the AI-generated, community and editorially authored translations — it is displayed non-commercially with attribution and is not relicensed here. Tier C, the authoritative modern-language translations and commentaries, is not served by the API and is not imported.
